root_cause: Original Agent Fabric suggestLearning called learningMemory.markReused and emitted LEARNING_REUSED on read-only lookup of a verified lesson. A suggestion could inflate reuseCount and falsely imply natural-agent adoption without execution, producer run ID, verified independent provider outcome or source revision.
prevention: Keep learning retrieval read-only with LEARNING_SUGGESTED. Apply only via admitted original Agent Fabric run, exact tenant/fingerprint/action/revision/side-effect reference and independently checked canonical original production verifier. Missing verifier remains application unproven. Preserve durable ONE BRAIN writer and provider/deduplication safety gates; no invented post readback or human OAuth consent.
